formulas.name: Whirlwind damage per attack (physical)
formulas.label: MODEL-VERIFIED
formula: 1. Weapon damage W_min/W_max = the attacking weapon's min/max damage stats. On the item: base damage (Weapons.txt) x (1 + ethereal 50% if eth) x (1 + weapon Enhanced Damage%/100), then + flat +min/+max on that weapon.
2. + 'Damage +N' (stat item_normaldamage; Grief's +340-400) added to BOTH min and max.

3. %pool = WW skill damage% [row 151 calc1 = ln12 = -50 + 8*(slvl-1)] + off-weapon %Damage (stat damagepercent and off-weapon ED) + Strength bonus (Weapons.txt StrBonus/100 * Strength; Phase Blade and Berserker Axe StrBonus = 100, i.e. +1% per Strength point) + matching weapon-mastery damage% + %damage vs demons/undead/montype. %pool is floored at -90.
4. min' = min x (1 + %pool/100); max' = max x (1 + %pool/100); roll uniform in [min', max'].
5. x SrcDam/128. Row 151 SrcDam = 128, so 100% of weapon damage.
6. Critical doubling (x2 physical), mutually exclusive, checked in order: weapon-mastery crit -> passive Critical Strike -> Deadly Strike (F09).
7. Elemental 'adds' (Grief's 5-30 fire, etc.) rolled separately and added; not multiplied by %pool or crit.
Each WW attack is one target and one weapon (see F02).

operands.bases: Phase Blade 31-35, WSM -30, StrBonus 100; Berserker Axe 24-71, WSM 0, StrBonus 100 (Weapons.txt)

sources: D2MOO D2Game/src/UNIT/SUnitDmg.cpp SUNITDMG_ApplyDamageBonuses + SUNITDMG_FillDamageValues; SkillBar.cpp SKILLS_SrvDo076_Whirlwind (damage.dwEnDmgPct = calc1)
BASIN Damage (order: base -> eth -> weapon ED -> +min/max -> Damage+ -> %Damage -> DS/CS -> elemental), Enhanced_Damage (weapon ED applies to base only; off-weapon ED joins %Damage)
ARREAT_COMBAT Whirlwind table (damage % per level) and TXT113 row 151
formulas.cross_check: Three-way agreement on the order of operations. WW damage% table reproduced exactly from row 151 vs Arreat (1-20) and Basin (1-60).
formulas.d2r_differs: D2R 2.4+: WW damage% = 5*slvl + 25 (Basin 'Levels 1-60 (D2R)'). Not the version of the pinned data.
open: The 'Damage +N' (item_normaldamage) is added in D2MOO before the %pool multiply; Basin lists it at step 5, also before %Damage. Agreement; no open item.

formulas.name: Whirlwind hit law: cadence, targeting, hand selection, procs
formulas.label: MODEL-VERIFIED (partial)
formula: CADENCE: re-used from the sister packet LAW_WW_CADENCE, not re-derived. Hit checks at ticks 4 and 8 always; then every D ticks on the 4-tick grid, D in {4,6,8,10,12,14,16} from the weapon's OWN IAS - WSM only.

TARGETING: each attack hits one target in a 5-subtile (3 1/3 yd) search radius that is also in melee reach; round-robin by unit GUID. Dual wield = up to two attacks per check, the second on the next target.
ATTACK RATING: each WW attack makes a normal hit check (F05) with skill tohit% = 5*(slvl-1) (row 151 LevToHit 5, ToHit empty).
TARGET-IN-MELEE-RANGE: if WW is started on a unit already in melee range, the game performs one normal Attack instead (no WW damage%/AR%).

PROCS: no chance-to-cast of any kind fires while whirling (On Attack, On Striking, When You Kill). So Grief's Venom, Death's Glacial Spike, Last Wish's Charged Bolt/Life Tap and BotD's Poison Nova never fire from WW.
INTERRUPTS: after the first attack nothing interrupts the whirl (hit recovery, block, knockback, stun). Death and weapon break are deferred to the whirl's end.

MANA: the mana cost (row 151; 12.5 at slvl 1, 22 at slvl 20, = 12 + 0.5*slvl) is paid ONCE when the whirl starts (SrvSt38 succeeds), not per hit. Row 151 has AttackNoMana=1: with too little mana the click falls back to a normal attack.

HAND SELECTION FOR D (resolves sister-packet Q4, INFERRED from code): row 151 weapsel=2. The 'current weapon' helper returns the RIGHT-hand item unless skill flag 0x2000 is set, then the LEFT-hand item. The flag is cleared at whirl start and toggled after every attack. Tick 4 makes one attack (right hand) -> flag set. From tick 8 on, D is computed BEFORE the attacks of that check, from the weapon the flag selects; two attacks per check toggle the flag twice, so it returns to the same state. Result: while both hands find targets every check, D is set by the LEFT-hand weapon for the rest of the whirl; when a check finds no second target the flag flips once and the other hand takes over.

formulas.name: Battle Orders
formulas.label: MODEL-VERIFIED
formula: +% max Life, max Mana, max Stamina = 35 + 3*(slvl-1)  (row 149 aurastat1-3, aurastatcalc ln34; Param3 35, Param4 3).
Duration (frames) = 750 + 250*(slvl-1) + 125*(Shout.blvl + Battle Command.blvl); 25 frames = 1 s. So 30 s + 10 s/slvl beyond 1, +5 s per synergy level.

Stat path: the % is the stat item_maxhp_percent / item_maxmana_percent (op 11 on maxhp/maxmana) -- the SAME stat as '+x% Maximum Life' on items, so BO% and item life% ADD. Op 11 applies the % to base max life + flat +life from all stat lists, but NOT to life that item Vitality adds (op 9 is a separate term). See F12.

Applies to current AND maximum life/mana/stamina, of the caster and allies in the wave (missile battleorders: Vel 30, Accel -500, Range 15; Basin: ~12 2/3 yd radius). The last cast overwrites, even a lower level.
Cast: SC animation, FCR-driven (sister packet LAW_BARB_FCR: 13 ticks at 0% FCR, release tick 9). Mana 7 at every level (mana 7, manashift 8, lvlmana 0).

operands.per-level table: primary_rows.json per_level_tables.battle_orders (slvl 20: +92%, 220 s with no synergy)

ARREAT_WARCRIES (35..92%, duration with the mandatory Shout point)

formulas.name: Attack rating (player)
formulas.label: MODEL-VERIFIED
formula: AR_base = 5*(Dexterity - 7) + tohit(flat, items) + CharStats ToHitFactor (Barbarian 20). L1 Barbarian: 5*(20-7)+20 = 85.
AR_eff = AR_base x (1 + tohit%/100), tohit% = skill tohit% (WW: 5*(slvl-1)) + weapon-mastery AR% + item 'Attack Rating +%' + attack-vs-montype%.
Flat AR vs demons / undead (Pul, Eld runes, etc.) adds to AR_base when the target is that type.
sources: D2MOO D2Common/src/Units/Units.cpp UNITS_GetAttackRate; D2Game SUnitDmg.cpp SUNITDMG_IsHitSuccessful
BASIN Attack_Rating ('((Dexterity - 7) * 5) + Class constant'; Barbarian constant 20, L1 AR 85)
TXT113 CharStats Barbarian ToHitFactor = 20
conflicts: Basin: the character-screen chance-to-hit display applies the class constant twice. Display-only; the server formula above is the one that rolls.

formulas.name: Chance to hit (attack rating vs defense)
formulas.label: MODEL-VERIFIED
formula: CtH% = clamp( 200 * AR/(AR + DEF) * alvl/(alvl + dlvl), 5, 95 ), integer math in D2MOO: factor = 100*AR/(AR+DEF), then 2*alvl*factor/(dlvl+alvl).

DEF = target defense (+ defense vs melee). Ignore Target's Defense sets DEF = 0 (see F11). '-x% Target Defense' reduces DEF by x% (halved vs bosses, superuniques, players, mercs; clamped 0-100). Negative DEF is added to AR instead.
A successful hit check also triggers Prevent Monster Heal (F13).
sources: D2MOO SUnitDmg.cpp SUNITDMG_IsHitSuccessful
ARREAT_CHARS 'Chance to Hit: 100 * AR / (AR + DR) * 2 * alvl / (alvl + dlvl)'; 5%/95% bounds
BASIN Attack ('100 * 2 * (alvl/(alvl+dlvl)) * (AR/(AR+DR))'; 5% floor, 95% ceiling)
open: Monster defense at a given area level comes from MonStats AC(H) scaled by MonLvl.txt (J-S7 tables). The scaling rule was not re-read here; it belongs to the frontier-table work (J-S7).

formulas.name: Physical mitigation: flat Damage Reduced, then % Damage Resist
formulas.label: MODEL-VERIFIED
formula: dmg_after = max(0, dmg - flatDR) x (100 - DR%)/100, flat first, then %.
Monster defender: DR% = MonStats ResDm(H) (+ curses); floor -100; NO ceiling; DR% >= 100 = Immune to Physical (damage x 0). Amplify Damage -100, Decrepify -50 (Arreat).
Player/merc defender: DR% clamped to [-100, 50].
Flat DR on a defender is reduced by the attacker's pierce% if any (D2MOO dwPiercePct /1024).
sources: D2MOO SUnitDmg.cpp SUNITDMG_CalculateTotalDamage + SUNITDMG_ApplyResistancesAndAbsorb (STAT_DAMAGERESIST max 50 for non-monsters; -100 floor)
ARREAT_RES ('Physical Resistance... lower capped at -100% and upper capped at 50%')
BASIN Damage_Reduced (flat applies first), Damage_Resist ('DR -100% is the floor, while DR > 99% makes a unit Immune'; player/merc ceiling 50%)
formulas.d2r_differs: Basin: renamed 'Physical Damage Received Reduced/Increased' in D2R; law unchanged.

formulas.name: Elemental resistance, caps, difficulty penalty, absorb
formulas.label: MODEL-VERIFIED
formula: dmg_after = max(0, dmg - flat MDR) x (100 - res)/100, then % absorb (capped 40) heals and removes, then flat absorb.

PLAYER/merc defender: res = item/skill res + DifficultyLevels ResistPenalty (Normal 0, Nightmare -40, Hell -100; DATAMINED) ; clamp to [-100, min(75 + max-res%, 95)]. Classic (non-expansion) game uses -20/-50 instead.

MONSTER defender: res = MonStats Res**(H) (+ curses/auras); floor -100; no ceiling; res >= 100 = immune. Item '-x% to Enemy Resistance' (pierce; Grief -20-25% poison, Obedience -25% fire) is subtracted ONLY if the monster's res < 100: items cannot break immunity.
Magic resist and physical are excluded from the difficulty penalty.
sources: D2MOO SUnitDmg.cpp SUNITDMG_ApplyResistancesAndAbsorb
TXT113 DifficultyLevels.txt ResistPenalty 0/-40/-100 (fetched from the same commit)
ARREAT_RES (base 0/-40/-100; max 75%, items to 95%; min -100; absorb cap 40%)
ARREAT_DIFF ('Player and Hireling resistances are lowered by 40 in Nightmare... by 100 in Hell')

formulas.name: Crushing Blow
formulas.label: MODEL-VERIFIED (partial)
formula: On a successful melee/ranged hit, with chance = sum of CB% (dual wield: attacking weapon's CB% plus non-weapon sources; Basin): target loses floor(currentHP / divisor), applied before the hit's damage.
divisor: normal / minion / champion / unique monster 4; boss or superunique 8; player or merc 10; x(1 + playercount HP bonus) for monsters = x(0.5 + 0.5*players); x2 for ranged attacks.
Then reduced by target DR% if DR% > 0 (DR >= 100 -> 0). Negative DR does not increase it; the player 50% DR ceiling does not apply to it. Not doubled by critical hits. Not reduced by flat DR.
CB on WW is melee (divisor not doubled).

operands.kit gear CB: Beast 20% (Ber rune), Death 50%, Last Wish 40-50% (Runes.txt says 40-50; Basin lists 60-70 for D2R/1.11 - see conflicts), Obedience 40%

sources: D2MOO D2Game/src/SKILLS/SkillItem.cpp SKILLITEM_EventFunc16_CrushingBlow; MONSTER/Monster.cpp MONSTER_GetHpBonus
BASIN Crushing_Blow (1/4, 1/8 superunique+boss, 1/10 player; halved ranged; divided by 0.5+0.5*players; DR caveats)

D2MOO also applies divisor 8 to SUPERUNIQUE via MONTYPEFLAG 0x02; Basin agrees. Champions and uniques stay at 4 in both.

formulas.name: Deadly Strike, Critical Strike, mastery crit
formulas.label: MODEL-VERIFIED (partial)
formula: Each physical hit: roll mastery crit (weapon-mastery 'critical' passive) -> else roll Critical Strike -> else roll Deadly Strike. Any success doubles PHYSICAL damage. They do not stack; combined chance = 100 - (100-a)(100-b)(100-c)/10000.
DS% = item DS% + DS/level stats (ItemStatCost op 2, param 3: value*clvl/8; Death 'deadly/lvl 4' = 0.5*clvl %). Grief: 20% (Lo rune). Dual wield: attacking weapon's DS only (Basin).
Elemental damage is not doubled.

BASIN Deadly_Strike (doubles physical; mutually exclusive with CS and mastery CS; combined-chance formula)
TXT113 ItemStatCost item_deadlystrike_perlevel op 2 / op param 3

formulas.name: Open Wounds
formulas.label: MODEL-VERIFIED
formula: On a successful hit with chance = OW% (Beast 25% from Um rune): target gets an 8 s (200-frame) bleed, HP regen -= drain per frame in 1/256 HP:
Champion/unique (and per Basin superunique/boss) x1/2; vs players x1/4 (ranged x1/8). Re-application resets duration. Not reduced by any damage reduction. HP/s = drain*25/256.
sources: D2MOO SkillItem.cpp SKILLITEM_CalculateOpenWoundsHpRegen + SKILLITEM_EventFunc15_OpenWounds
BASIN Open_Wounds (piecewise table; multipliers)

conflicts: Which monsters get x1/2: D2MOO tests type flags 0x0C (champion|unique); Basin also lists superunique and boss. Superuniques normally carry the unique flag; act bosses may not. Minor; flagged.

formulas.name: Ignore Target's Defense and -% Target Defense
formulas.label: MODEL-VERIFIED (partial)
formula: ITD (Grief, Last Wish via Jah): target defense treated as 0 for the hit check, so CtH = 200*alvl/(alvl+dlvl) clamped 5-95 (95% when alvl >= dlvl). Not vs uniques, superuniques, bosses, mercs, players.

-x% target defense (Eth rune 25% on Grief and BotD; Obedience): defense x (1 - x/100), x halved vs bosses/superuniques/players/mercs. 'Damage target AC' (flat) lowers monster AC permanently per hit (FillDamageValues).

formulas.name: Life and mana scaling (Barbarian)
formulas.label: MODEL-VERIFIED
formula: Base life = 55 + 2*(clvl-1) + 4*(Vitality_allocated - 25)  [CharStats: hpadd 30 + starting vit 25; LifePerLevel 8/4; LifePerVitality 16/4].
Max life = (base life + flat +Life from items/skills) x (1 + sum(maxhp%)/100) + 4*(Vitality from items). maxhp% = BO% + item '+x% Maximum Life' (same stat, additive).
Base mana = 10 + 1*(clvl-1) + 1*(Energy_allocated - 10)  [ManaPerLevel 4/4; ManaPerMagic 4/4]. Max mana = (base + flat +mana) x (1 + maxmana%/100) + 1*(Energy from items).
Stamina: 92 base, +1/level, +1/Vitality (CharStats StaminaPerLevel 4/4, StaminaPerVitality 4/4); BO adds skill_staminapercent (op 1).
sources: TXT113 CharStats.txt Barbarian (hpadd 30, vit 25, LifePerLevel 8, LifePerVitality 16, ManaPerLevel 4, ManaPerMagic 4, int 10, stamina 92) + ItemStatCost ops (vitality op 9 -> maxhp; energy op 8 -> maxmana; item_maxhp_percent op 11)
D2MOO D2StatList.cpp (op 8, 9, 11)
BASIN Life (Barbarian 55, +2/level, +4/Vitality), Mana (Barbarian 10, +1/level, +1/Energy), Barbarian_(Diablo_II) attribute table
open: CharStats ManaRegen = 120 (Barbarian). Its exact meaning (seconds to regenerate full mana at 0 regen bonus) was not verified against code here. UNKNOWN; settle in D2MOO stat regen or Basin 'Mana' regeneration section.

formulas.name: Life / mana leech
formulas.label: MODEL-VERIFIED
formula: Applies to the PHYSICAL damage actually dealt, after mitigation, capped at the target's remaining HP.
life gained = phys x LL%/100 x Drain/100 / LifeStealDivisor;  mana gained = phys x ML%/100 x Drain/100 / ManaStealDivisor.
Drain = MonStats Drain / Drain(N) / Drain(H) for the target (a blank cell parses as 0, and D2MOO then skips leech entirely). Divisors (DifficultyLevels, DATAMINED): Normal 1, Nightmare 2, Hell 3.
Kit gear: BotD 12-15% LL, Vex 7% ML; Grief has no leech. The kit record says 'mana leech via ring/weapon' but names no ring.
sources: D2MOO SUnitDmg.cpp SUNITDMG_ExecuteEvents (nDrain from MonStats; /dwLifeStealDiv, /dwManaStealDiv for player attackers; % of dwPhysDamage)
TXT113 DifficultyLevels LifeStealDivisor/ManaStealDivisor 1/2/3; MonStats Drain columns
ARREAT_DIFF ('Life/Mana Stealing... cut in 1/2 in Nightmare'; 'cut 2/3 in Hell')
open: Blank Drain(H) for Diablo and Uber Mephisto = no leech under D2MOO's code path. Not checked in game. Settle with a 1.13 test.

formulas.name: Damage vs demons / undead, prevent heal, on-kill effects, weapon auras
formulas.label: MODEL-VERIFIED (partial)

Prevent Monster Heal (Mal rune on Grief/BotD/Beast): set on a successful hit check; stops the monster's natural regeneration.

+Life after each kill (Grief 10-15, Enigma 14), +Mana after each kill (Tir +2): event funcs HealAfterKill / ManaAfterKill. WHETHER WW kills fire them: UNKNOWN (Arreat's 'When You Kill' exclusion reads as chance-to-cast; Basin is silent).
Weapon auras (Beast: Fanaticism lvl 9; Last Wish: Might lvl 17) are persistent auras. Their rows (Fanaticism, Might) are NOT in this packet's scope; UNKNOWN numbers.
